fact: A workshop held in Bangui on 10-11 November 2021 presented the studies for the Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2020-2025 (PNS CD 2025) to participants from all ministries, opened by the Ministry cabinet director.
title: Centrafrique : restitution des études relatives au Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2025 et au SNID
